text.p: Periphonics Corp said Monday it was increasing the estimated earnings for its third quarter to between $0.20 and $0.22 per share.
Its earlier projection was in the range of $0.15 and $0.22 per share.
The company said that for the quarter, it expects its net income to be between $2.7 million and $3.1 million on revenues of about $29.3 million.
In the prior year's third quarter, Periphonics reported net income of $2.28 million, or $0.17 per share after accounting for a two-for-one stock split, on revenues of $23.40 million.

Periphonics develops, markets and supports automated interactive transaction processing systems that allow individuals to interact with computer databases using a touch-tone telephone, speech input, fax and Web browsers.
